id: 58_How are genetically engineered microbes used for hazardous waste cleanup trendin
title: 基因工程微生物如何用于危险废物治理？
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/58_How are genetically engineered microbes used for hazardous waste cleanup trendin.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/58_How are genetically engineered microbes used for hazardous waste cleanup trendin/src.py

points.K1: 改造细菌，清理危险废物
points.K4: 当生物传感器：发现污染就报信
points.K5: 例子：遇砷发光的工程大肠杆菌
points.K6: 工程菌的风险：生态、伦理与监管

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，身旁浮着一个DNA双螺旋和细菌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab bench beside a floating DNA double helix icon and a bacterium icon, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 改造过基因的细菌，能帮忙治污。
overlay: 工程菌治污：本事大，规矩更大

shots.scene: 欣欣指向一个细菌图标和一个盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a bacterium icon and a shield icon side by side.
shots.narration: 今天讲它的本事，也看它的风险。

shots.scene: 阿杰在组会上兴奋地展示一张空白示意图
shots.prompt_en: The young male student excitedly presents a blank diagram at a group meeting.
shots.narration: 阿杰读到工程菌治污，很兴奋。

shots.scene: 阿杰头顶冒出一个问号气泡，里面是细菌和废物桶
shots.prompt_en: A thought bubble above the young male student shows a bacterium next to a hazardous waste drum, with a question mark.
shots.narration: 他问：细菌到底是怎么改的？

shots.scene: 老周笑着拿起白板笔
shots.prompt_en: The older man smiles and picks up a whiteboard marker.
shots.narration: 老周说：主要有三个方向。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 先看工程菌能做什么。

shots.section_title: 改造细菌，清理危险废物
shots.scene: 一个细菌图标里，一段DNA被剪刀剪开换上新片段
shots.prompt_en: Inside a bacterium icon, a piece of DNA is snipped by small scissors and a new colored segment is inserted. No people.
shots.narration: 科学家改造细菌的基因，
overlay: 改造细菌，清理危险废物

shots.section_title: 改造细菌，清理危险废物
shots.scene: 改造后的细菌朝一堆带骷髅象形图的废物桶前进
shots.prompt_en: The modified bacteria move toward a pile of waste drums with skull pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 让它们专门对付危险废物。

shots.section_title: 改造细菌，清理危险废物
shots.scene: 三个空白方框依次出现：剪刀、盾牌、灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: Three blank boxes appear one by one with icons: scissors, a shield, and a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 主要往三个方向改。

shots.scene: 细菌内部的小工厂图标加速运转，冒出很多酶图标
shots.prompt_en: A tiny factory icon inside a bacterium speeds up and releases many small enzyme icons. No people.
shots.narration: 一是让它多产降解酶，

shots.scene: 污染物分子被大量酶图标快速剪碎，旁边一个快进的时钟
shots.prompt_en: Pollutant molecules are quickly cut apart by many enzyme icons, with a fast-forward clock beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 污染物分解得更快。

shots.scene: 普通细菌在深色毒物液体中萎缩
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary bacterium shrinks and fades in a dark toxic liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 二是让它耐得住毒。

shots.scene: 工程菌在同样的深色液体中依旧精神，外围有盾牌
shots.prompt_en: An engineered bacterium with a small shield around it stays healthy in the same dark toxic liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 毒物浓度高，也能活下来干活。

shots.section_title: 当生物传感器：发现污染就报信
shots.scene: 细菌图标遇到污染物分子，身上亮起一盏小灯
shots.prompt_en: A bacterium icon touches a pollutant molecule and a small light switches on inside it. No people.
shots.narration: 三是把它变成生物传感器，
overlay: 当生物传感器：发现污染就报信

shots.section_title: 当生物传感器：发现污染就报信
shots.scene: 一管水样里亮起点点光，旁边一个铃铛图标
shots.prompt_en: A tube of water sample glows with small dots of light, a bell icon ringing beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 一碰到污染物，就发出信号。

shots.section_title: 例子：遇砷发光的工程大肠杆菌
shots.scene: 试管里一团细菌，旁边一个带骷髅象形图的小瓶
shots.prompt_en: A test tube of bacteria next to a small vial with a skull pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 举个例子：工程大肠杆菌，
overlay: 例子：遇砷发光的工程大肠杆菌

shots.section_title: 例子：遇砷发光的工程大肠杆菌
shots.scene: 试管在暗处发出绿色荧光
shots.prompt_en: The test tube glows with green fluorescence in a dark room. No people.
shots.narration: 水里有砷，它就发出荧光。

shots.section_title: 例子：遇砷发光的工程大肠杆菌
shots.scene: 两支试管对比：一支发光一支不发光
shots.prompt_en: Two test tubes side by side: one glowing green, one dark. No people.
shots.narration: 一看亮不亮，就知道有没有砷。

shots.section_title: 工程菌的风险：生态、伦理与监管
shots.scene: 一个放大镜照着一株工程菌，旁边三个警示图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over an engineered bacterium, with three warning icons nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 但工程菌也有风险。
overlay: 工程菌的风险：生态、伦理与监管

shots.section_title: 工程菌的风险：生态、伦理与监管
shots.scene: 工程菌进入河流，与当地小生物混在一起，打问号
shots.prompt_en: Engineered bacteria drift into a river and mix with local tiny creatures, with question marks above them. No people.
shots.narration: 放到野外，可能打乱原有的生态。

shots.section_title: 工程菌的风险：生态、伦理与监管
shots.scene: 盾牌和天平图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon and a balance scale icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 所以必须考虑伦理，接受监管。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三个图标前：酶、盾牌、发光灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of three icons: an enzyme, a shield and a glowing light bulb.
shots.narration: 一起回顾一下。

shots.scene: 发光的试管
shots.prompt_en: A test tube glowing green in the dark. No people.
shots.narration: 工程菌还能当传感器，遇砷发光。

shots.scene: 放大镜下的工程菌和三个警示图标，旁边盾牌和天平
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over an engineered bacterium with three warning icons, next to a shield and a balance scale. No people.
shots.narration: 也要看风险，考虑伦理和监管。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研一起挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 本事要用好，风险要看清，下次见！
